elements.element: Services performed in a professional manner
elements.evidence: "will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner"

elements.element: Services performed in a workmanlike manner
elements.evidence: "professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards"
"will conform in all material respects to its documentation and specifications" (conformance stated, though qualified by "in all material respects")
"for a period of twelve (12) months following delivery"
the services warranty in (a) carries no duration; no 90-day period appears anywhere
"or a refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming Interface, software or services"
"will comply in all material respects with all laws applicable to its performance"
"free of viruses, worms, Trojan horses and other malicious code"
"twelve (12) months following delivery" exceeds the 90-day floor
services warranty in (a) is stated with no duration at all
"repair or replacement, or a refund of the fees paid"

reasons: The inserted services warranty (clause (a)) has no duration, so neither the preferred 90-day services period nor the fallback 30-day services period is expressed; the drafter's locked preferred level therefore fails on a duration element.
The remedy set adds "re-performance" and makes the election "at TrueLink's option", which goes beyond the playbook remedy set (repair, replacement, refund) and hands the election to the vendor.
Documentation conformance is diluted by "in all material respects" and broadened by "and specifications"; the preferred position calls for straight conformance to documentation.
Compliance with laws is qualified by "in all material respects" and "consistent with industry standards" softens the professional/workmanlike standard — extra words not needed to complete the level.
Untouched terms (Y2K warranty, disclaimer paragraph) remain effective and no undefined term or dangling mechanic is introduced, so intent is preserved.
